stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class); no Common Data Set was found on Campbell's website or by web search. Counts from the IPEDS admissions file (via the Urban Institute API mirror): 6,956 applicants, 6,064 admitted, 616 enrolled (598 full-time + 18 part-time). The same source shows 3,680 applicants / 3,470 admitted for fall 2023, so the 2024 applicant count may include a reporting change. Campbell is test-optional and College Navigator shows no SAT/ACT percentiles. International applicant counts, GPA and class-rank data are not published. College Navigator shows 2% of undergraduates as U.S. nonresidents. Undergraduate enrollment (2,699) is the main campus; total enrollment is 4,963 with graduate and professional programs.
